    5. The Apple TV doesn't support Profile 7, according to several sources including the Infuse forum. They mention that it actually falls back to HDR10, but your TV will trigger Dolby Vision (DV). This is often referred to as fake DV.
      Fake DV = Triggers DV on your devices but you're actually playing the HDR10 base layer.

      However, one of our team members tested it and his setup triggered DV on his TV and his AVR. We can't say for sure if this is fake DV or real DV. ↩↩↩

    6. The Apple TV doesn't support Profile 8, according to several sources including the Infuse forum. They mention that it actually falls back to HDR10, but your TV will trigger Dolby Vision (DV). This is often referred to as fake DV.

      Suppose you want a box that can run premium Android applications and CoreELEC. In that case, the best overall device is the Homatics Box R 4k Plus with its support for Dolby Vision including FEL and AV1 with a certified Android TV box. However, CoreELEC will run slower than the Ugoos and may not be able to decode some older Blu-ray movies as it does not support the VC1 codec. ↩

    38. It should play Profile 7 releases without issues.
      But:
      FEL/MEL will be played as single layer.
      MEL means, the EL is just empty, so Profile 7 BL+MEL+RPU is totally identical to Profile 8 BL+RPU ↩

    40. Supports Dolby Vision including FEL and 3D on CoreELEC -ng. They can decode 24fps VC-1 content using a software decoding. Somewhat faster than S905X4-J devices, but more expensive and lack hardware support for AV1. CoreELEC can be installed on the emmc and HS400 enabled which greatly reduces boot time and speeds up which greatly reduces boot time and speeds up the interface making it feel significantly faster than the S905X4.

      If you want the best media box to only run CoreELEC, then the Ugoos AM6b+ is the best box with its faster processor and the ability to install COREelec to the emmc with HS400, but it runs an older version of Android and sacrifices support for certified apps including Netflix and AV1. However, only the Ugoos AM6b+ can fully replace a disc-based player. ↩

    41. The AM6B+ can play both FEL and MEL DV P7 as well Single Track and Dual Track ↩↩↩

    43. There are special consideration, where the audio setup will modify the EDID profile that gets send from the TV to the Zidoo, cutting some framerate/resolution combinations. In some cases this lead to a frame or two skipping every now and then, because the framerate of the video didn't match the TV.
      See this thread on how to get the best EDID for your setup (even if this is not an issue for you, as there are other benefits): https://forum.zidoo.tv/index.php?threads/edid-thread-rtd1619bpd-players.96829/ ↩↩↩↩
